קעה.ja: ג'מיע ד'לך, וחיל בינה ובין ג'מיע מא בני ואכתסב קדימא וחדית'א, ולם יג'ד ענד כ'רוג'ה שיא ממא כאן לה פי אלמדינה וכ'ארג'הא, פבקי נאדמא וחזינא עלי ג'דה ואג'תהאדה פימא בני וג'מע וצאר אלי גירה.
קעה.en: he was prevented from everything he had built and acquired, anciently or recently. At his going out he found nothing of what had been his in the city or outside; he remained regretful and grieving over his striving and his exertion at what he had built, gathered, and lost to another.

pairs.ja: וחיל בינה ובין ג'מיע מא בני ואכתסב
pairs.en: he was prevented from everything he had built and acquired
anciently or recently
At his going out he found nothing

pairs.ja: ממא כאן לה פי אלמדינה וכ'ארג'הא
pairs.en: of what had been his in the city or outside
he remained regretful and grieving
over his striving and his exertion
at what he had built, gathered
and lost to another

קעה.ja: ת'ם וקע אסתחסאן אהל תלך אלמדינה עלי רג'ל גריב ד'י לב ופהם, פלמא ולי אמרהם אכ'תץ רג'לא מנהם פאחסן אליה ולטף בה,
קעה.en: Then the people of that city happened to approve of a foreigner who was possessed of inwardness and understanding. When he held rule over them, he singled out a man among them, treated him well, and dealt subtly with him;

pairs.ja: ת'ם וקע אסתחסאן אהל תלך אלמדינה
pairs.en: Then the people of that city happened to approve

pairs.ja: עלי רג'ל גריב ד'י לב ופהם
pairs.en: of a foreigner who was possessed of inwardness and understanding
When he held rule over them
he singled out a man among them
treated him well, and dealt subtly with him

קעה.ja: ת'ם סאלה ען סר אלקום וסנתהם מע מן תולי אמרהם קבלה, פכשף לה אמרהם וסרהם ומד'הבהם בה,
קעה.en: then he asked him about the secret of the folk and their custom with whoever had held rule over them before him. He uncovered for him their matter, their secret, and their school.

pairs.ja: ת'ם סאלה ען סר אלקום וסנתהם
pairs.en: then he asked him about the secret of the folk and their custom
with whoever had held rule over them before him

pairs.ja: פכשף לה אמרהם וסרהם ומד'הבהם בה
pairs.en: He uncovered for him their matter, their secret, and their school

קעה.ja: פלמא עלם בד'לך מנהם לם ישתגל בשי ממא אשתגל בה אלאוול אלד'י ד'כרנא, בל סעי ואג'תהד פי אכ'ראג' כל מעני נפיס פי תלך אלמדינה אלי מדינה אכ'רי,
קעה.en: When he knew this from them, he occupied himself with nothing of what the first occupied himself with, but rather strove and exerted himself in bringing out every precious item from that city to another city.

pairs.en: When he knew this from them

pairs.ja: לם ישתגל בשי ממא אשתגל בה אלאוול אלד'י ד'כרנא
pairs.en: he occupied himself with nothing of what the first occupied himself with
but rather strove and exerted himself
in bringing out every precious item

pairs.ja: פי תלך אלמדינה אלי מדינה אכ'רי
pairs.en: from that city to another city

קעה.ja: וג'על ד'כ'אירה ומהמאת עלאיקה פי סואהא, ולם יאנס אלי ברהם ותבג'ילהם לה,
קעה.en: He made his treasures and important commodities in some other city, and did not find comfort in their honor and reverence for him.

pairs.ja: וג'על ד'כ'אירה ומהמאת עלאיקה פי סואהא
pairs.en: He made his treasures and important commodities in some other city

pairs.ja: ולם יאנס אלי ברהם ותבג'ילהם לה
pairs.en: and did not find comfort in their honor and reverence for him

קעה.ja: וכאן בין אלחזן ואלפרח טול מכת'ה פי אלמדינה, אמא מזנה פלסרעהֵ כ'רוג'ה מנהא ואסתקלאלה למא אכ'רג' מן אלפואיד ענהא, פלו טאל מקאמה פיהא לאמכנה אלזיאדה פי ד'לך.
קעה.en: He was, the whole length of his sojourn in the city, between sorrow and joy: as for his sorrow, it was on account of the swiftness of his going out from it and his reckoning small what he was able to bring out from it of useful things — had his standing in it been long, he might have increased in this.

pairs.ja: וכאן בין אלחזן ואלפרח טול מכת'ה פי אלמדינה
pairs.en: He was, the whole length of his sojourn in the city, between sorrow and joy
as for his sorrow, it was on account of the swiftness of his going out from it

pairs.ja: ואסתקלאלה למא אכ'רג' מן אלפואיד ענהא
pairs.en: and his reckoning small what he was able to bring out from it of useful things

pairs.ja: פלו טאל מקאמה פיהא לאמכנה אלזיאדה פי ד'לך
pairs.en: had his standing in it been long, he might have increased in this

קעה.ja: ואמא פרחה בסרעהֵ כ'רוג'ה מן אלמדינה ליסתקר פי אלמכאן אלד'י ג'על פיה ד'כ'אירה ויסתעמלהא פי וג'וה מנאפעה וצ'רוב לד'אתה ברכ'א באל וסכון נפס ודואם חאל.
קעה.en: As for his joy, it was at the swiftness of his going out from the city, that he might settle in the place where he had placed his treasures, and employ them in the aspects of his benefits and the kinds of his pleasures, with prosperity of mind, quiet of soul, and continuity of state.

pairs.en: As for his joy
at the swiftness of his going out from the city

pairs.ja: ליסתקר פי אלמכאן אלד'י ג'על פיה ד'כ'אירה
pairs.en: that he might settle in the place where he had placed his treasures

pairs.ja: ויסתעמלהא פי וג'וה מנאפעה וצ'רוב לד'אתה
pairs.en: and employ them in the aspects of his benefits and the kinds of his pleasures

pairs.ja: ברכ'א באל וסכון נפס ודואם חאל
pairs.en: with prosperity of mind, quiet of soul, and continuity of state

קעה.ja: פלמא אנקצ'י עאמה לם יחזנה כ'רוג'ה ענהם, בל סארע אלי ד'לך בסמאחהֵ נפס וטלאקהֵ וג'ה, שאכרא לסעיה חאמדא לפעלה,
קעה.en: So when his year ran out, his going out from them did not grieve him; rather, he hastened to it with openhandedness of soul and a clear face, thankful for his striving, praising himself for his action —

pairs.en: So when his year ran out
his going out from them did not grieve him
rather, he hastened to it
with openhandedness of soul and a clear face
thankful for his striving, praising himself for his action

קעה.ja: פצאר אלי אסבג נעמה ואתם חרמה ואכמל כראמה פי סרור מתצל, פאגתבט פי אלחאלין, ונאל אלאמל פי אלדארין.
קעה.en: and he reached the most ample blessing, the most complete dignity, and the most perfect honor in continual joy. He was envied in both states, and attained his hope in both houses.

pairs.ja: פצאר אלי אסבג נעמה ואתם חרמה ואכמל כראמה
pairs.en: and he reached the most ample blessing, the most complete dignity, and the most perfect honor
in continual joy
He was envied in both states
and attained his hope in both houses

קעה.ja: ואנא אכ'אף אן תכון חאלי חאל אלג'אהל אלד'י שקי פי אלדארין וכ'סר אלמחלתין,
קעה.en: And I fear that my state may be the state of the ignorant one, who was miserable in both houses and lost the two stations.

pairs.en: And I fear
that my state may be the state of the ignorant one
who was miserable in both houses
and lost the two stations

קעה.ja: פאד' קד מן אללה עליי בך, פארשדני ובצרני בחאלי ומא וקפת עליה מן סר אמרי ווג'וה מצלחתי.
קעה.en: Since God has now bestowed bounty upon me through you, guide me and give me insight into my state, and what I have stood upon of the secret of my matter and the aspects of my welfare.

pairs.ja: פאד' קד מן אללה עליי בך

pairs.ja: ומא וקפת עליה מן סר אמרי ווג'וה מצלחתי

קעה.ja: קאל אלעקל, קד וצפת פי מא תמת'לת בה
קעה.en: The intellect says: You have described, in what you have likened,
